body.title: Electricity cost
body.markdown:
What the always-on devices at 12 Maple Street cost. The wattages come from their entries, so the numbers follow when an entry changes.

```calc
title: Electricity cost per year
Electricity price (€/kWh) = 0.32
Homelab rack (W) = @homelab-rack.power
Chest freezer (W) = @chest-freezer.power
Freezer runs (h/day) = @chest-freezer.hours_per_day
Rack per year (€) = ROUND(Homelab_rack * 24 * 365 / 1000 * Electricity_price)
Freezer per year (€) = Chest_freezer * Freezer_runs * 365 / 1000 * Electricity_price
Together per month (€) = (Rack_per_year + Freezer_per_year) / 12
```

Change the price to try next year's tariff; nothing is saved.

elements.source:
title: Solar panels on the garage roof
Panels = 8
Peak power per panel (W) = 430
Yield (kWh/kWp) = 950
Own use (%) = 35
Price (€/kWh) = 0.32
Feed-in (€/kWh) = 0.08
Cost (€) = 7900
Yield per year (kWh) = Panels * Peak_power_per_panel / 1000 * Yield
Saved per year (€) = ROUND(Yield_per_year * (Own_use / 100 * Price + (1 - Own_use / 100) * Feed_in), 0)
Pays off after (years) = ROUND(Cost / Saved_per_year, 1)
